title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Autopay Terms
content:
**Autopay terms for Ridgeline Consumer Credit.** Autopay is enrolled, changed or cancelled only on the cardholder's own instruction, and can be enrolled or changed on accounts whose status is active or suspended.

- **Options.** The option chosen must be one of the tier's autopay options. With the fixed-amount option the draft is the greater of the fixed draft amount and the minimum payment due; with the statement-balance option it is the full statement balance.
- **Lead time.** A change made at least the tier's autopay lead time in business days (Monday to Friday, excluding federal holidays) before the next payment due date applies to that due date; a later change applies from the following due date.
- **Cancelling.** Cancelling turns autopay off, sets the option to none and the fixed draft amount to 0.00.
- **Drafts.** Autopay drafts post as payments through the autopay channel on the due date and never incur a phone payment fee.

## Questions answered

**The cardholder's spouse calls to switch the cardholder's autopay. Can it be done?** Autopay changes only on the cardholder's own instruction.

**The account is suspended. Can the cardholder enroll?** Yes; enrollment and changes are open on accounts whose status is active or suspended.

**A fixed draft of 150.00 is set. What is drafted when the minimum due is 95.00, and when it is 180.00?** 150.00 in the first case and 180.00 in the second — the greater of the two.

**With a 3-business-day lead time, when does a change take effect?** Made 3 or more business days before the next due date, it applies to that due date; made 2 business days before, it applies from the due date after.
